## About
U.S.A. Tires is a tire shop on St Clair Ave. in Cleveland. Al is the owner and operator. Skye runs the office, Dan handles the mechanical work and Twan is our tire tech.
We fix flats, sell and install tires, and take care of basics like oil changes and brakes. We stay open late every day, so if a tire gives out on the freeway at night, give us a call.
Customers rate us 4.2 on Google from 37 reviews. One reviewer said it looks like we're trying to build a community around the shop. That's what we're going for.

## Services
- Tire repair: Picked up a nail or a screw? Twan repairs and installs tires on cars, trucks and heavy vehicles.
- All sorts of tires: We carry all sorts of tires. Stop in and we'll find one that fits your car.
- Installing and balancing tires: We install, balance and repair tires for passenger cars and commercial vehicles.
- Changing oil and rotating tires: Dan handles oil changes, fluid checks and tire rotations.
- Brake and parts repair: Dan repairs or replaces worn parts like brake pads, wheel bearings and sensors, and explains what's wrong before the work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you provide emergency services?
A: Yes. We provide emergency and non-emergency services throughout the greater Cleveland area. Call the cell line and we'll help you out.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. Sunday hours are 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM, same as the rest of the week.

Q: How fast will you confirm my appointment?
A: We'll confirm your appointment within 30 minutes and work to get your car back to you as quickly as we can.

Q: Will I know who's working on my car?
A: Yes. We'll give you the technician's name when you book, and you'll meet them when you drop off your car.
